personality_one_liner: A warm, accessible, and inviting space for older adults, focusing on clarity, large readable text, and gentle contrast with warm teal highlights.

spacing.rule: Ensure large, comfortable tap targets (minimum 44x44pt). Spacing must separate logical groups distinctly for cognitive ease.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar to maintain context
dont's: Do not use on post cards or dense content

screens.name: Moments
screens.purpose: A social feed showcasing shared photos and updates from friends with large, legible text and warm card boundaries.

states.empty: Illustration of friends with 'No moments yet.' and 'Refresh' primary CTA
states.error: Readable text 'Unable to load moments' and a 'Retry' button

screens.layout: Use a FlatList. Each post card uses 'surfaceSecondary' (warm teal-tinted off-white) with 1pt 'border' color and 'lg' border-radius. Margin bottom 'xl' between posts for clearer separation. Header: Avatar (48pt), Name (base or lg weight 500), Timestamp (muted). Footer: Like/Comment/Flutter action buttons with large touch targets. Savi-style layout for 1 photo (where appropriate): Row direction, text caption on left (flex: 1), photo on right (width 120pt, aspect ratio 1:1 or 3:4). For 2 photos: Caption above, row gap xs, 2 images flex 1 (1:1). For 3 photos: Caption above, left image flex 2 (2:3), right column flex 1 with 2 stacked images (1:1). For 4 photos: 2x2 grid. For 5+ photos: 2x2 grid, 4th image has a dark gradient scrim and '+N' text centered.

screens.name: More
screens.purpose: A clear, grouped list of all remaining app sections that don't fit in the main 6-tab navigation.
screens.layout: ScrollView. Sections grouped by category. Group 1: Chats, Notifications. Group 2: Profile/Settings, Help. Group 3: Games, Notice Board, Community Groups, Recipes, Founding Members. Each row is 56pt minimum height, flex row, align center. Leading icon (muted, 24pt), title (lg weight 500), trailing chevron (muted). A 1pt divider separates rows within a group. xl margin between groups.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design the bottom tab navigation with EXACTLY 6 tabs: Home, My Friends, FP Café, Moments, Events, More.

Bottom Tab Specs: Height 90pt (including bottom safe area) to accommodate tap targets. Tab width is flex: 1 (approx 16.6%). Active tab state MUST use a rounded pill background (brandTertiary) behind the icon, filled icon (brandPrimary), and label (brandPrimary, font size 10pt/11pt). Inactive tabs: outlined icon, muted label.

Moments Feed: Implement the 'Savi-style' single-photo layout (caption left, photo right) to save vertical space where appropriate. Implement the multi-photo grid rules (2 side-by-side, 3 layout, 4 grid, 5+ grid with +N overlay).
Moments Feed styling: Use surfaceSecondary for the card background to give it the requested warmer blue/teal tint, with 1pt border. Use lg radius and xl margin-bottom for clear separation.
More Menu: Render a clean grouped list for remaining items. Ensure each tap target is at least 56pt high with a trailing chevron.
